scholarshipName: SSP Karnataka Post-Matric Scholarship (2025/26)
provider: Government of Karnataka • Department of Technical Education
grantAmount: ₹25,000 - ₹50,000 / year (Direct Tuition Fee Reimbursement)
eligibility: Karnataka domicile students enrolled in accredited technical institutions (VTU / Autonomous / State Universities). Parental annual income within state prescribed limits.
academicCriteria: Minimum 50% marks in previous qualifying examination (10+2 / PUC or prior semester).
maxIncome: Parental income < ₹2.5 LPA (SC/ST < ₹10.0 LPA as per Karnataka welfare norms)
notes: Direct bank disbursement through Karnataka K-Kisan Aadhaar linked accounts.

scholarshipName: Vidyasiri (e-Pass) Food & Hostel Scheme

academicCriteria: Passing marks in qualifying examination; minimum 75% attendance.

scholarshipName: KMDC Arivu Education Loan / Freeship Scheme

academicCriteria: Admitted through CET counseling in accredited engineering stream.

scholarshipName: Karnataka Labour Welfare Board Educational Scholarship

academicCriteria: Minimum 50% marks in previous semester or PUC/12th standard.

scholarshipName: Karnataka Brahmin Development Board (Chanakya & Sandipani Scheme)
